Q: Can I include case studies or patient examples in my assignment?

Yes, case studies and clinical examples are an excellent way to show how theory can be applied in practice and are welcomed in UK nursing assignments. However, it is important that:

  • Patient identifying details are anonymised by removal or alteration;
  • NMC Code (2018) guidelines on confidentiality are followed;
  • Examples are used to support clinical reasoning, reflection, or evidence-based practice;
  • Scenarios are clearly linked to theoretical models and learning outcomes.

 

For example, if the focus is on the case of pressure ulcer management, references to NICE will be made and reflections on how theory shaped decisions will be discussed. https://www.basilicasm.com/
